trigger: Someone fills in your form, messages on Facebook or Instagram, or emails you
steps: Sorted by job type, area and urgency
A reply is drafted in your words
A call slot is offered from your calendar
The lead is logged with where it came from
approve: You check the drafted reply before it goes, or let routine ones send on their own

trigger: A customer picks a slot from your real availability
steps: Confirmation sent straight away
Reminder the day before
They can move or cancel without ringing you
Your diary updates itself
approve: You set the hours, buffers and which jobs can be booked online

trigger: A job is marked as done
steps: Invoice goes out the same day
Polite reminder at 7 days, another at 14
Payments are matched to the right invoice
You get a list of anything still overdue
approve: You set the timings and the wording, and anything past 30 days comes to you

trigger: A job is finished or an order is delivered
steps: A day or two later, a short message with a one-tap Google review link
One reminder if there's no response
Then it stops
approve: You choose which customers get asked, and nothing is sent to anyone who complained

trigger: A customer asks something on your site or by message
steps: Answered from replies you've written and approved
Anything new or unusual is handed to you
The full conversation comes with it
approve: It only ever uses answers you've signed off. Anything else waits for you

steps: A friendly check-in after 3 days
A last nudge after a week
Replies come straight to your inbox
Accepted quotes are flagged so you can book the job
approve: You write the messages once and can stop the follow-up on any quote

trigger: Every Monday morning, or whenever suits
steps: Sales, enquiries and where they came from collected
Put into one short report
Sent to your inbox
approve: You choose the numbers that matter. Nothing to log in to

trigger: You write a month of posts in one sitting
steps: Each post is scheduled for the day you picked
Goes out to each channel
A weekly note of what went out
approve: Nothing posts that you haven't written or approved

steps: Confirmation email
Dispatch email with tracking
Delivered email
Low-stock alert when a product runs low
approve: You write the emails once and set the stock levels
